title: BreachBench Lab API (Vulnerable vs. Hardened Second-Brain Surface)
description: Self-contained lab API planting OWASP API Top 10 flaws alongside hardened counterparts modeled on Trapni (Genesis Second Brain).

endpoints.owasp_category: API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR)
endpoints.flaw_summary: Fetches note by note_id directly from global store without verifying X-Account-Id session ownership, allowing cross-account note read.
endpoints.remediation: Enforce per-account storage key isolation (brain:{accountId}:data) and verify session account matches note owner before returning.

endpoints.flaw_summary: Accepts unlimited 6-digit TOTP verification attempts without rate limiting, lockout backoff, or replay window tracking.
endpoints.remediation: Enforce exponential backoff on failed attempts (recordFailure), bind TOTP challenge to a short-lived HMAC pending cookie, and reject replayed TOTP time-steps.

endpoints.owasp_category: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
endpoints.flaw_summary: Mass-assigns 'role' and 'approved' fields directly from client JSON payload and returns passwordHash and totpSecret in the HTTP response.
endpoints.remediation: Explicitly allowlist input fields (email, name, passcode), force non-first accounts into 'pending' member role, and return only AccountPublic fields.

endpoints.flaw_summary: Accepts arbitrarily large audio buffers with no byte-size cap or per-device rate limit, enabling memory exhaustion and upstream Whisper API billing abuse.
endpoints.remediation: Cap upload payload at 10 MB, enforce per-session rate limits, and require an authenticated session cookie.

endpoints.flaw_summary: Allows any signed-in member session to approve pending signups or revoke devices without checking requireAdmin(req) or requireRecent(req).
endpoints.remediation: Gate administrative endpoints behind both requireAdmin(req) and step-up re-authentication requireRecent(req).

endpoints.owasp_category: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
endpoints.flaw_summary: Publicly callable background Gmail IMAP sync route that executes without verifying Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET.
endpoints.remediation: Require constant-time comparison against CRON_SECRET header before triggering background IMAP sync.

endpoints.flaw_summary: Fetches user-supplied URLs and automatically follows 302 redirects to internal metadata IPs (169.254.169.254) or non-allowlisted hosts.
endpoints.remediation: Enforce strict hostname allowlist (assertEgress), block private/link-local IPs, use redirect='manual', and re-validate Location headers on 3xx responses.

endpoints.flaw_summary: Sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true and dumps raw process environment keys on error.
endpoints.remediation: Restrict CORS to same-origin, disable debug environment dumps, and sanitize error responses.

endpoints.flaw_summary: Deprecated v0 migration endpoint left enabled in production that exports raw brain.json without session or bearer token checks.
endpoints.remediation: Decommission legacy v0 routes and require authenticated admin session + step-up confirmation for exports.

endpoints.owasp_category: API10:2023 Unsafe Consumption of APIs (Indirect Prompt Injection)
endpoints.flaw_summary: Concatenates raw untrusted email body directly into the system prompt and trusts unvalidated LLM output to mark phishing verdicts or execute actions.
endpoints.remediation: Wrap untrusted content in quarantineData fences, append QUARANTINE_RULE to system prompt, redact foreign secrets, and keep phishing verdicts deterministic.
